title: Crashes after quitting game - Vulkan on AMD Radeon 7800XT on Arch Linux
body:
### Tested versions

I've tried on all this versions with same problem
godot 4.4.1-6
godot-beta-bin 4.5beta7-1
godot-preview-bin 4.5rc2-1


### System information

Godot v4.5.rc2 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 04 Sep 2025 23:18:13 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (RADV NAVI32) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 62.69 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot crashes to desktop after quitting the game, I've tried quite alot of the demos with same result.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open any godot sample
2. Run game
3. Quit game
4. Now I get a quick freeze of the godot UI and then the whole godot terminates.
